rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the written text of a play, film, or other performance.

example.english: I still haven't read the script for this movie.
example.traditional: 我仲未睇過呢套戲嘅劇本。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 mei6 tai2 gwo3 ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 kek6 bun2

rows.note: Use this in a computing context for a short program that automates a task, though it can also mean a program more generally.

example.english: This script renames all my files with one click.
example.traditional: 呢個程式一撳掣就幫我改晒檔名。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 jat1 gam6 zai3 zau6 bong1 ngo5 goi2 saai3 dong2 meng2

rows.note: Use this for a writing system when the language or people using it makes that meaning clear.

example.english: This script is still used in Japanese.
example.traditional: 呢種文字喺日文入面仲用緊。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 man4 zi6 hai2 jat6 man4 jap6 min6 zung6 jung6 gan2
